title: Aggregate AI Cockpit installation and lifecycle diagnosis
rawUserRequest: Execute the remaining plan automatically through completion and record that authorization in every Work Item Contract. Resolve issue #621 by making ai-doctor present requested and installed version, source commit, tag/digest installation facts, available Make targets, active or blocked Outcome, hosted snapshot readiness, contradictions, and deterministic recovery actions in one diagnostic output.

declaredIntent.summary: Give adopters and maintainers one deterministic, evidence-backed diagnosis of installation and lifecycle truth, including explicit contradictions and recovery actions.

outOfScope: Changing installation, version, release, Work Item, Outcome, or hosted receipt facts as a side effect of diagnosis.
Contacting GitHub, hosted CI, an adopter, or any other external provider from ai-doctor.
Adding a temporary or free-text diagnostic bypass that masks contradictions.

sources.reason: Authoritative requested diagnostic facts, contradiction detection, and recovery-action acceptance.
Existing local diagnostic entrypoint and current environment/adoption findings.
Version, requested/installed, source commit, tag, and digest installation-truth boundary.
Canonical active and archived lifecycle/Outcome fact reader.
Canonical hosted-snapshot and Work Item state boundary.
Canonical terms for repository truth, Outcome, evidence, human status color, and recovery signals.
Most recent completed Contract and Outcome behavior, including external receipt and traffic-light truth.

riskAssessment.reason: A doctor that silently prefers one conflicting version, lifecycle, hosted receipt, or command fact can cause unsafe updates, unsupported operation, or a false completion diagnosis. The output must be deterministic, local, and fail closed on contradictory evidence.
riskAssessment.unknownsReviewReason: Issue #621 and existing local fact readers define the requested evidence and recovery boundaries; implementation does not require provider access.

reasons: The Work Item modifies lifecycle- and installation-truth diagnostics consumed by maintainers and adopters.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized automatic execution of every remaining Work Item and requested that authorization be recorded in each Contract. #621 only reads local repository evidence and has deterministic acceptance and verification.

preReviewWarnings: Do not choose one version or lifecycle fact when evidence conflicts; report every source and a concrete recovery action.
Do not make ai-doctor mutate installation, Outcome, hosted receipt, branch, or provider state.
Keep commands and generated capability/documentation facts aligned with the executable diagnostic output.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: make ai-doctor reports in one deterministic, human-readable output the requested and installed template version, immutable source commit/tag/digest installation facts, and every detected contradiction with the exact source paths and recovery action.

The same output reports available relevant Make targets, active/blocked Outcome state and traffic-light color, and hosted-verification snapshot readiness or its explicit blockers without claiming an external action completed.

Malformed, absent, stale, or contradictory version metadata, manifests, Outcome records, and hosted-snapshot evidence fail closed as warnings or failures rather than being silently selected or hidden.

Focused regressions cover consistent facts, each requested contradiction category, blocked Outcome, missing/ready hosted snapshot, and deterministic recovery text; existing installation and project-doctor tests remain compatible.

The canonical command and lifecycle documentation enumerate ai-doctor's installation, lifecycle, Outcome, target, and hosted-snapshot sections with their recovery semantics; generated capability and multilingual alignment evidence state that same bounded fact model.
guidelines: Use deterministic local evidence only; ai-doctor must never mutate repository or provider state or infer a fact that is absent.
Surface all contradictions with their evidence locations and actionable recovery; do not hide conflicts behind a preferred source.
Keep command output, tests, canonical documentation, and generated capability evidence semantically aligned.
Use existing public local fact-reader boundaries rather than importing private feature internals or duplicating their parsing logic.

intent.problem: Installation facts, version metadata, manifests, available commands, Outcome state, and hosted verification readiness are currently distributed across files and commands. When they disagree, maintainers must manually cross-check data and can incorrectly treat a stale or partial fact as authoritative.
constraints: Diagnosis must be deterministic and read-only.
Every contradiction must identify its evidence and recovery action.
The output must preserve fail-closed lifecycle and external-receipt semantics.
No provider polling, credentials, machine-specific paths, or temporary bypass behavior may be added.
intent.rationale: A single evidence-derived diagnostic lets maintainers make a correct recovery decision without weakening the authority of immutable installation, Outcome, or hosted-receipt records.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: All installation, lifecycle, target, Outcome, and hosted snapshot facts agree.
scenarioCoverage.expected: ai-doctor prints the unified fact set and its ready or clean recovery signal deterministically.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Version metadata, manifest, source commit, tag, or digest facts are missing, stale, or contradictory.
scenarioCoverage.expected: ai-doctor reports each conflict with locations and a fail-closed recovery action rather than choosing one fact.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An active Outcome is blocked or incomplete.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The state, human status color, failed gate, and recovery condition are visible in the unified diagnosis.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Hosted verification has no snapshot, a stale snapshot, or a matching ready receipt.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The diagnosis accurately reports readiness or blocker without provider calls or completion claims.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A maintainer needs the executable command and documented recovery guidance.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Canonical docs and generated capability evidence match the diagnosed facts and recovery model.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Documentation metadata/alignment regression and generated evidence checks.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized automatic execution of all remaining Work Items, Contract writes, PRs, lifecycle closure, final audit, and release.
